title: Pullback of a finite locally constant etale sheaf
statement: Let $g:Y'\to Y$ and $f:Y\to T$ be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and let $F$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For a morphism $h:W\to T$ write $h^{-1}F$ for the sheafification of the presheaf pullback of $F$ along the base-change functor $T_{\Et}\to W_{\Et}$, $V\mapsto V\times_TW$, as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and likewise $g^{-1}$ for sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$. If $f^{-1}F$ is finite locally constant on $Y_{\Et}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], then $(f\circ g)^{-1}F\cong g^{-1}(f^{-1}F)$ and this sheaf is finite locally constant on $Y'_{\Et}$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 095A (lemma-pullback-locally-constant, line 9960), with Lemma 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback) (3) for the geometric stalks and Sites Lemma 03CB (lemma-composition-morphisms-sites) for $(f\circ g)^{-1}\cong g^{-1}f^{-1}$

proof.text: The base-change functors for the morphisms $f$ and $g$ define morphisms of the corresponding small etale sites. Applying the composition theorem for morphisms of sites gives the canonical natural isomorphism $(f\circ g)^{-1}F\cong g^{-1}(f^{-1}F)$ on abelian sheaves.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03CB and the sentence after Definition Tag 03CC

proof.text:
Write $G=f^{-1}F$ and choose an etale covering $\{j_i:U_i\to Y\}$ such that each restriction $G|_{U_i}=G\circ\iota_{j_i}$ is isomorphic, as a sheaf of sets, to a constant sheaf of sets $\underline{E_i}_{U_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Put $U_i'=U_i\times_YY'$ with projections $k_i:U_i'\to Y'$ and $g_i:U_i'\to U_i$, so $g\circ k_i=j_i\circ g_i$; the $k_i$ are etale and jointly surjective [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change], i.e. an etale covering of $Y'$. For each $i$ there are isomorphisms of abelian sheaves on $(U_i')_{\Et}$
$$(g^{-1}G)|_{U_i'}\cong k_i^{-1}g^{-1}G\cong(g\circ k_i)^{-1}G=(j_i\circ g_i)^{-1}G\cong g_i^{-1}j_i^{-1}G\cong g_i^{-1}(G|_{U_i}),$$
by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] (1) for the etale morphisms $k_i$ and $j_i$ (the latter transported by the functor $g_i^{-1}$) and [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (2) twice. Passing to underlying sheaves of sets, the underlying sheaf of sets of $g_i^{-1}(G|_{U_i})$ is the set-theoretic inverse image of the underlying sheaf of sets of $G|_{U_i}$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures] (3), hence (by functoriality of the set-theoretic inverse image) isomorphic to $g_i^{-1}\underline{E_i}_{U_i}$, which is isomorphic to the constant sheaf $\underline{E_i}_{U_i'}$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-constant-sheaf]. Thus $g^{-1}G$ is locally constant. For a geometric point $\bar y'$ of $Y'$ with image $\bar y=g\circ\bar y'$, [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] gives $(g^{-1}G)_{\bar y'}\cong G_{\bar y}$, which is finite since $G$ is finite locally constant; hence $g^{-1}G$ is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: Lemma 095A (lemma-pullback-locally-constant) via Modules on Sites Lemma 093R, with Lemma 03Q1 (3); restriction to an etale U is j^{-1} (Section 03S2, after Definition 03S3)

proof.text: Combining the canonical isomorphism of Step 1 with the local constancy and finite-stalk conclusion of Step 2 proves $(f\circ g)^{-1}F\cong g^{-1}(f^{-1}F)$ and that this sheaf is finite locally constant on $Y'_{\Et}$.
